title: DbDataBuild model definition
description: A model definition file (models/**/<name>.yml), the companion of the plain DuckDB-dialect <name>.sql body. This schema is for editors; `dbdatabuild validate` applies the same rules plus semantic checks (name against path, grain against unique_key, column references) with diagnostic codes. The tool reads every scalar as a string, so values here that YAML would type (nullable) accept the quoted and unquoted forms.

name.description: Schema-qualified model name. Must equal the path under models/ with '/' replaced by '.' (models/marts/fct_orders.yml is marts.fct_orders).

grain.description: Columns that uniquely identify an output row. Required for incremental kinds; for incremental_by_unique_key it must equal unique_key.

targets.description: Engines the model must be valid for. The project's default_targets apply if omitted.

columns.description: The declared output schema. Required for every model: it drives the shape hash, the plan's DDL, and offline validation.

renames.description: Declared column renames. Renames are never inferred.

loads.description: Named load operations (not validated yet; arrives with the load-operations milestone).

kind.description: Table semantics, and the default load operation.

oneOf.title: view
oneOf.description: View over upstream. DDL only; apply issues no data statements.

oneOf.title: full
oneOf.description: Table fully reloaded: transactional delete and insert.

oneOf.title: incremental_by_time_range
oneOf.description: Time-sliced incremental. The range comes from MAX(time_column) in the target minus lookback. Requires time_column.

type.description: A SQL type written as a plain string, for example `BIGINT` or `DECIMAL(14, 2)`.

collation.description: Logical collation name from the project's string_semantics.collations. The project default applies if omitted.
